PROJECT MANNEQUIN STYLE LOCK. Characters define rendering grammar only; do not include them. Keep bright occupancy under 4 percent and the central 72 percent calm. No paving network, seam rows, continuous line, border, frame, ring, grid, perspective, walls, props, hazards, text, symbols, photorealism, PBR, scratches, dense texture, or baked shadows.
